## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Validation

List the commands, tests, checks, or evidence used to validate the change.

## Scope / risk

State what this PR changes and what it deliberately does not change.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is bounded to the stated scope.
- [ ] Relevant tests and checks pass.
- [ ] No private client/source data or credentials are included.
- [ ] Architecture and documentation are updated when the contract changes.
